description: This file defines the code-behind for the login page of an online examination system, handling user login logic for students and teachers, and transferring control based on credentials.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the login page, managing user authentication and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the sign-up button click by transferring to the SignUpPage.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click, authenticates user as student or teacher, and redirects to respective pages upon successful login.
